requirements.text: Formal training on software engineering concepts and 3+ years of applied experience in native mobile application development.
Proficiency in Swift programming language, including modern concurrency patterns like async/await and Combine.
Strong experience with iOS frameworks such as UIKit, SwiftUI, Foundation, Core Data, and design patterns like MVVM and SOLID.
Demonstrated expertise in writing unit tests using XCTest and UI tests using XCUITest with a commitment to test-driven development.
Experience with CI/CD processes, Git source control management, and building reusable SDKs or frameworks.
